card_text: Which haircut to book from Roswell, matched to how long you're making the trip down 285.

seo.title: Men's Haircuts for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Three haircuts for anyone driving from Roswell, cut in Carlsbad about 92 minutes south on US 285. Pick the one that fits your trip and book on Booksy.

paragraphs: My chair is in Carlsbad, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles south of Roswell on {{city:roswell.route}}, with Artesia at the halfway point. Call it {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes each way (OpenStreetMap routing), which is long enough that the haircut you book should match the kind of trip you're making.
Three cuts are on my Booksy menu. One is quick, one adds the beard, and one turns the visit into the whole afternoon.

blocks.heading: Errand day or barber day?
paragraphs: If Carlsbad is one stop on a list, the Essential Haircut keeps you in the chair for {{minutes:essential-haircut}} and sends you back out with the neckline razored clean. If you've driven {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes for the haircut alone, the Luxury Grooming Experience makes more sense of the mileage: consultation, cut, beard sculpt, wash, steam, two hot towels and a fragrance finish in one sitting.
The Signature Cut sits in between, and it's the one to pick when your beard needs lining up with the cut.

blocks.heading: The three on the menu.
blocks.lead: Prices and minutes come straight from Booksy.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The cut, a razor-clean neck and a finished style. Nothing added, nothing missing.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Cut plus beard trim or line-up, hot towel and razor detailing. Your beard rides home sharp too.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Everything I do around a haircut, in one {{minutes:luxury-grooming}} booking. Worth it when the drive is the reason for the day.

blocks.heading: Different schedules than Carlsbad.
paragraphs: Only {{city:roswell.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} of Roswell's workers are in mining, oil and gas or agriculture, against {{city:carlsbad.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} here in Carlsbad (Census ACS 2023). If your week is booked solid, Saturday is the open window: I'm in from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
Booksy shows the weekday slots too. Text me at {{phone}} if nothing lines up.

items.q: How long is the drive from Roswell for a haircut?
items.a: About {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes and {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles, straight down {{city:roswell.route}}. The shop is at {{address}}.

items.q: Which haircut should I book if I'm short on time?
items.a: The Essential Haircut. Booksy holds {{minutes:essential-haircut}} for it, so you're back on 285 well inside the hour.

items.q: Can I add a wash to the Essential or Signature?
items.a: Yes. A wash and scalp massage is an add-on at {{addon:wash-scalp-massage}}. It's already part of the Luxury Grooming Experience.
